status: Planning assumptions only; not historical accounts, booked revenue, vendor quotations or a funding commitment.

historical_actuals.reason: Founder records have not been reconciled for this model. Absence of evidence must not be recorded as a zero balance.

funding.initial_request_gate: Founder approves operating/availability assumptions; programme confirms the validation scope and eligible costs; written investment terms; funds received before spending.

follow_on_reviews.gate: Evidence review complete, demand interviews support buyer need, one signed paid-pilot scope or budget-authorised LOI, Qatar formation and cash requirements quoted. Size any request from remaining approved costs and available cash.
Pilot independently reviewed and customer accepts value; at least one paid continuation or second paying buyer; local hiring plan and remaining cash need re-costed. No automatic follow-on funding.

base_hypothesis.description: Illustrative execution path, not a forecast. One new paid pilot/month from month 4, recurring service grows after pilots.

downside_hypothesis.description: Stress path only: later, fewer pilots; 90-day collection lag. Spending is held at the same envelope to expose risk, although actual gates should stop it earlier.

unpriced_exclusions: Tax, withholding, social insurance, visa and employment obligations depend on the eventual entity and contracts; the administrative and all-in employment allowances require qualified local quotes.
Founder relocation, family support and residency proof-of-funds are not established or committed. A separate required blocked/bank balance would be additional capital, not an operating expense.
No credits, waived fees, free office, awarded grants, unpaid invoices or future investment count as cash receipts.
